confirmation_definition: the receipt log at the reported event index is emitted by the reported Fluid pool; the event direction maps the pool's on-chain token0 and token1 identities to the labelled sold and bought tokens; Fluid's native-ETH sentinel and WETH are one economic asset; and both event amounts reproduce the reported quantities
coverage_definition: pool-identity-testable legs divided by sampled Fluid legs
eligible_population: coherent, unambiguous route components containing at least one Fluid leg, 2024-10-29 through 2026-06-30
precision_denominator: legs with the exact Fluid swap event and an evidence-backed on-chain pool constants call
receipt_source: eth_getTransactionReceipt with complete logs and historical constantsView eth_call
sample_design: within each half-year: 20 highest-value and 10 rank-spread cross-venue components; 10 highest-value and 5 rank-spread Fluid-only components; at most one component per transaction
transfer_note: exact ERC-20 Transfer amounts are reported separately because Fluid's central liquidity layer can net or combine settlement flows
wrapped_native_note: literal native-ETH pool sides are counted separately and then mapped to WETH for the paper's economic-asset route identity
